item.text:
CodeGraph emits value-reference edges to make impact analysis see when a file-scope constant, config object, or lookup table change should reach the same-file symbols that read it, since calls/imports/inheritance alone miss that class of dependency. This is the “Value-reader impact reachability” problem, and the intended win is correct blast-radius computation, not fewer reads.  

It keeps the edges precise by emitting only additive `references` edges from reader symbols to same-file `const`/`var` targets, deduping per reader-target pair, and applying shadow-pruning guards so obvious false positives are dropped while node counts stay unchanged.
